project.name: Worth Query Graph Authority Hardening Gate

phases.title: Global Discovery And Gate Harness
acceptance: machine-readable inventory and deletion ledger exist
unclassified audited source rows fail certification
root authority family discovery records are represented
lower-authority promotion compile-fail plan is explicit
phases.instructions: Build the generic scoreboard first. Prefer compiler-led discovery and typed inventory/deletion rows over prose. Do not begin crate cleanup beyond what is needed to expose and classify the roots.
phases.qa_focus: Inventory completeness, deletion-ledger action honesty, no filename-only classification, no production debt hidden as certification language.

phases.title: Forge Query Contract Baseline
acceptance: canonical Query graph obligation and Consumer Kit surfaces are named
Worth cannot substitute local adoption status for graph execution proof
missing Query capability blockers become query-gap rows
phases.instructions: Pin the Query surfaces Worth may consume before rewriting crate internals. Keep this phase short and contract-focused; do not build Worth-local substitutes for missing Query capabilities.
phases.qa_focus: Query proof vocabulary exactness, Consumer Kit usage, no local required-family lists, no fabricated receipts, query-gap rows for real blockers.

phases.title: `worth-topo` Authority Cleanup And QA
acceptance: cargo check -p worth-topo
topology operator catalog lowers to Query descriptors and registrations
raw handoff, admitted handoff, compose execution, denial, receipt, and envelope are phase-typed
topo public facade exposes proof/status without forgeable internals
topo deletion ledger rows are resolved
phases.instructions: Clean worth-topo as one vertical slice. Topology owns topology semantics; Query owns graph obligation selection and execution authority. Include facade and compile-fail lockdown in this phase.
phases.qa_focus: Blueprint proof-obligation duplication, local guard residue, handoff-only promotion, public constructor leakage, topology geometry boundary violations.

phases.title: `worth-spatial` Evidence Cleanup And QA
acceptance: cargo check -p worth-spatial
spatial evidence cannot satisfy Query graph authority by itself
production evidence lookup uses typed evidence-stage index products
raw evidence rows and string stage links cannot satisfy production APIs
split and loop ledger identities remain replay-stable
phases.instructions: Clean worth-spatial as one vertical slice. Spatial owns geometry evidence, witnesses, tolerances, events, split/loop evidence, and replay parity. It must not promote spatial evidence into Query graph authority.
phases.qa_focus: Spatial graph-authority promotion, raw evidence scan leftovers, copied row vectors, string-prefix stage linkage, digest drift after Query accompaniment.

phases.title: `worth-kernel` Construction Authority Cleanup And QA
acceptance: cargo check -p worth-kernel
covered primitive construction birth executes through Query graph authority
handoff-only construction proof is rejected or explicit residue
primitive family inventory is mechanically consistent or residue
primitive birth selector is exact or blocked by query-gap
phases.instructions: Clean worth-kernel as one vertical slice. Kernel owns construction orchestration and workload composition; it must consume lower-crate receipts and Query proof rather than forging authority.
phases.qa_focus: Handoff-only proof, broad primitive birth selector matching, support summary duplication, primitive family count drift, lower-authority compile-fail gaps.

phases.title: Boolean Chain Integration And Ledger Exclusivity
acceptance: 7.5-facing consumers accept ledger receipts plus required Query proof
raw split fragments, continuation maps, copied digests, and local graph legality rows are rejected
Query graph evidence does not change split or loop ledger digest identity
remaining boolean prep ceremony is explicit capped residue
phases.instructions: Fence the boolean handoff surface that 7.5+ will inherit. Do not implement 7.5 overlap-region extraction. Preserve 7.3 split-ledger and 7.4 loop-ledger exclusivity.
phases.qa_focus: Raw fact reopening, ledger digest drift, Query proof replacing domain ledgers, accidental 7.5 functionality, local graph legality leaks.

phases.title: Performance And Complexity Contracts
acceptance: graph obligation selection exposes exact structural counters
evidence-stage lookup exposes exact indexed lookup counters
production broad scans fail where indexed products are required
large admitted boolean-prep workload scales with declared breadth
phases.instructions: Add performance-visible proof after crate-local cleanup has removed transitional paths. Use structural counters, not elapsed-time claims.
phases.qa_focus: Hidden broad scans, repeated selector rediscovery, timing-as-proof, counters hidden away from the boundary being claimed.

phases.title: Cross-Crate Closeout Certification
acceptance: cargo check -p worth-topo -p worth-spatial -p worth-kernel
closeout matrix covers every Phase 1 audited source
public facades expose adoption/proof posture through ordinary APIs
synthetic proof, local support pins, copied rows, handoff-only receipts, raw vectors, and string links fail closeout
closeout doc states residue and Query gaps before broad 7.5 work
phases.instructions: Close the gate only after the certification suite exists. Prove zero silent covered-lane bypass and report deletion/residue/query-gap counts by class.
phases.qa_focus: API-presence-only closeout, happy-path-only proof, residue deletion without anti-bypass tests, roadmap/spec drift, unowned remaining debt.
